comment: The protections ledger (G2.8). Each guarantee the product makes, the one-line change to ONE file that breaks it, and the test file that must then FAIL. scripts/mutate.mjs applies each change in a temporary copy and runs only that test. A guarantee whose test still passes is undefended; a change that no longer applies means the ledger is stale. Add a row when a guarantee is added; never delete one to make the run green.
